credits.title: Santa Claude
credits.overview: A distinguished lawyer who finds himself having to perform community service after committing a blunder: getting into a shouting match with a mascot during a Christmas parade.

credits.title: Follies
credits.overview: After 16 years together, François and Julie open their relationship to explore sexual adventures and self-discovery. With two kids and their bond at stake, the path proves more complex than expected.

credits.title: Little Goodbyes
credits.overview: A cold December night. After a series of peculiar encounters, two little girls cling to the last remaining glimpses of Christmas magic.

credits.title: Heat Spell
credits.overview: A hot summer day. A half-unpacked house. A mother who needs room to breathe, and a child who needs space to truly exist. As the afternoon heat turns oppressive, time seems to move entirely differently for each person.
